metadata.title: HxH Status - Publication & Production Tracker
metadata.description: A sourced, unofficial tracker for HUNTER×HUNTER publication history and Yoshihiro Togashi's confirmed production progress.
metadata.imageAlt: HxH Status publication and production tracker with current chapter milestones

scheduled.description: Jump has scheduled this chapter for publication.

delivered.description: The finished manuscript has been delivered to Jump, but it is not published yet.

background.description: Instructions for backgrounds and supporting production work are complete.
